fusions.name: Hotfoot
fusions.desc: A leaping strike at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 4 fire damage, up to 1.8 times that at the full 6 tiles, and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spotfires
fusions.desc: Throws a spark at the first enemy in a line up to 8 tiles away that deals 26 fire damage, ignoring resistances, then jumps to 4 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the first. Every enemy hit is [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Smoulder Coat
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it and sets them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Warmth Seeker
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds. You have 10% fire resistance.
